```plato

    //==
    // IMeshIncidence obligations — edge side.

    // The two endpoints of an undirected edge, ordered A.Value <= B.Value to
    // match the canonical ordering of `UndirectedEdgeList`
    // (`topology.types.plato`). Direction is not recoverable from an
    // undirected edge; read the naming corner for that.
    VerticesOfUndirectedEdge(self: PolygonMesh3D, edge: UndirectedEdgeIndex): VertexPair
    {
        var corner = self.CanonicalCornerOfUndirectedEdge(edge);
        var a = self.CornerVertex(corner);
        var b = self.CornerDestination(corner);
        return a.Value <= b.Value ? (a, b) : (b, a);
    }
```
